name: signwell
description: Model Context Protocol server that orchestrates SignWell's e-signature workflows — create, send, track, and manage documents and templates.

tools.name: document_create
tools.description: Create a SignWell document draft for e-signature

file_token.description: Token from file_store (recommended). Use file_store first, then pass the token here.

content_text.description: Plain text or Markdown content to convert to DOCX. When provided, the MCP server generates a DOCX file automatically. Use this instead of file_base64 to avoid UI freezing with large documents.

subject.description: Email subject line recipients will see.

apply_signing_order.description: When true, recipients sign one at a time in the order of the recipients array.

copied_contacts.description: CC recipients who receive the final signed document by email.

expires_in.description: Days before the signature request expires (max 365).

reminders.description: Send signing reminders on day 3, 6, and 10.

allow_reassign.description: Allow recipients to reassign to someone else.

redirect_url.description: URL to redirect after successful signing.

decline_redirect_url.description: URL to redirect if document is declined.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata (max 50 pairs, key max 40 chars, value max 500 chars).

embedded_signing_notifications.description: Send completion notifications when using embedded signing.

tools.description: List SignWell documents with filters and pagination

tools.name: document_get
tools.description: Fetch a SignWell document by ID

tools.name: document_send_draft
tools.description: Send a draft document for signing

tools.name: document_send_reminder
tools.description: Send a signing reminder to recipients

files.description: REQUIRED. Files to upload. Each needs 'name' plus one of: 'file_url', 'file_base64', or 'resource_uri'.

file_token.description: Token from file_store (recommended). Use file_store first, then pass the token here.

file_url.description: Public URL to download the file.

resource_uri.description: MCP resource URI for the file.

content_text.description: Plain text or Markdown content to convert to DOCX. When provided, the MCP server generates a DOCX file automatically. Use this instead of file_base64 to avoid UI freezing with large documents.

placeholders.description: REQUIRED. Signing roles. Each needs 'id' and 'name'. For text tags, the 'id' must match tag IDs (e.g., id='signer1' matches [sig|req|signer1]).

id.description: REQUIRED. Unique ID that maps to the signer number in text tags (e.g., '1' for {{signature:1:y}}, '2' for {{signature:2:y}}).

name.description: REQUIRED. Role name (e.g., 'Parent/Guardian', 'Client'). Used when assigning recipients via template_create_document.

text_tags.description: Set TRUE if PDF contains text tags like {{signature:1:y}}. Placeholder 'id' values must match the signer numbers in tags (e.g., id='1' for {{signature:1:y}}).

message.description: Email message for signature requests (max 4000 chars).

draft.description: If true, template stays editable. If false, marked Available. Default: false per API.

copied_placeholders.description: Recipients who receive the final document after completion.

name.description: REQUIRED. Name for the CC recipient role.

fields.description: 2D array of fields: one array per file. Required if draft is false.

placeholder_id.description: ID of the placeholder assigned to this field.

label.description: Label displayed when field is empty (text/date fields).

value.description: Pre-filled value. Text accepts strings/numbers, date accepts ISO8601, checkbox accepts boolean.

fixed_width.description: Text fields: keep fixed width with multiline.

lock_sign_date.description: Date fields: auto-populate with sign date.

reminders.description: Send signing reminders on day 3, 6, and 10.

redirect_url.description: URL to redirect after successful signing.

decline_redirect_url.description: URL to redirect if document is declined.

allow_reassign.description: Allow recipients to reassign to someone else.
